user.title: Connect to your Victron GX device
user.description: Enter the address of the Cerbo GX (or other Venus OS device). The portal ID is detected automatically.

relays.title: Name the Cerbo GX relays
relays.description: Give the two relays meaningful names for this install (e.g. Internal Fan, External Fan). You can change these later in Options.

reconfigure.title: Update GX device connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or credentials of this GX device (e.g. if its IP address changed). The device identity must match the original.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the MQTT broker. Check the address and that MQTT is enabled on the GX device.
error.no_portal: Connected, but no Venus portal was detected. Is this a Victron GX device?
error.different_device: Connected, but that is a different GX device (portal ID mismatch). Add it as a new integration entry instead.

abort.already_configured: This GX device is already configured.

tuning.title: Clever Caravan: Power options
tuning.description: Per-install tuning. The battery flow deadband sets how many watts count as “Idle” before the Battery Flow Direction sensor reports Charging or Discharging — raise it if the direction flickers at rest.

data.ssh_key_path: SSH private key path (for Reboot SSH button)

ble.title: Victron Bluetooth fallback
ble.description:
Paste the Instant Readout encryption key for each discovered Victron device to add it as an offline fallback. When MQTT is available it stays primary; if the Cerbo or network drops, these devices keep the battery, solar and DC-DC readings alive over Bluetooth. Get each key from the VictronConnect app: device → Settings → Product info → “Show” under Instant readout via Bluetooth.

{summary}

data.unignore: Un-ignore devices (start nagging about them again)
data.ble_discovery: Bluetooth discovery (turn off once this rig's devices are added)

data_description.ble_discovery: When off, other caravans' Victron devices are never flagged, and existing discovery issues and the ignored list are cleared.

error.invalid_key: That key isn't valid. A Victron advertisement key is exactly 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes). Copy the whole key from VictronConnect and try again.

init.title: Victron {kind} found over Bluetooth
init.description: A Victron {kind} ({address}) is advertising over Bluetooth but has no key configured. Add its key to use it as an offline fallback, or ignore it if you don't want it.

menu_options.stop_discovery: Stop Bluetooth discovery (clears all of these)

add_key.title: Add Bluetooth fallback key
add_key.description: Paste the Instant Readout encryption key for the Victron {kind} ({address}). Get it from VictronConnect: device → Settings → Product info → “Show” under Instant readout via Bluetooth. Leave blank and submit to go back.

error.invalid_key: That key isn't valid. A Victron advertisement key is exactly 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes). Copy the whole key from VictronConnect and try again.
